query.description:
Supported items for filter: contractId, type, status, contractEndDate

        - contractId: Contract ID to filter by
        - type: Renewal type (AUTOMATIC, UNILATERAL, MUTUAL, NONE)
        - status: Renewal status (DRAFT, APPROVED, DECLINED)
        - contractEndDate: Filter by term end date in YYYY-MM-DD format
